name: Lund University Global Scholarship
requiredDocuments: A complete degree-programme application submitted via universityadmissions.se with the Lund University programme as your first choice, and the application fee paid
Scholarship Motivation Letter (maximum 600 words, distinct from the programme statement of purpose) — explaining why your academic achievements and reasons for applying make you a strong candidate
Application submitted through the separate scholarship application portal (link posted on the page when the round opens)

timeline.resultsBy: Shortly after admission results (notified by Lund University)
timeline.notes: Dates are from the autumn-2026 entry cycle (now closed as of access date 2026-06-18). The application 'usually opens in early February every year'; the next cycle had not opened at the timeline anchor (2026-06), so the most recent completed cycle is documented. Master's programmes apply via the regular (mid-January deadline) application round; a separate March–April round exists for some programmes/Fine Art/Music.

benefits: Tuition-fee scholarship — grant may cover part or all of the tuition fee
Awarded percentage is set by programme/faculty budget (not by academic standing)
Scholarship amount is automatically deducted from the Lund University tuition-fee invoice

acceptanceRate.estimateNote: No acceptance rate is published. Lund University does publish award volume: '110 Lund University Global Scholarships were awarded' and 'SEK 26 million (EUR 2.4 million)' awarded annually (Scholarship key facts 2026, https://www.lunduniversity.lu.se/study/admission-degree-studies/scholarships-and-awards). Selection is highly selective, competitive and merit-based only — financial need is not considered.

mustKnow: TUITION-ONLY: covers part or all of the tuition fee — living costs are NOT included. Recipients must self-fund living expenses to meet the Swedish Migration Agency residence-permit requirement.
Two-step process: you must FIRST submit a complete degree application and pay the application fee at universityadmissions.se, THEN apply through the separate scholarship portal.
The Lund University programme must be your FIRST CHOICE in your universityadmissions.se application or you should not apply.
Merit-based only — financial need is not considered in selection.
You may only apply for ONE Lund University Global Scholarship per application round, but you may apply for other scholarships (e.g. Swedish Institute) in addition.
If selected, the remaining tuition instalment may be due EARLIER than the standard tuition payment deadline for non-scholarship holders.
Special conditions apply for Music and Fine Arts programmes; a separate March–April round has its own emailed instructions.
eligibleNationalities: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Bangladesh qualifies (non-EU/EEA); Lund explicitly lists Bangladesh among scholarship-recipient countries.
renewalConditions: Award letter states acceptance/payment conditions; scholarship applies to the admitted programme. No GPA-renewal condition stated on the official page.
